info.title: devsforfun ID API
info.description:
"Sign in with devsforfun ID" — the public integration API for satellite apps.

Authentication schemes (see securitySchemes):
- **projectHmac** — server-to-server endpoints for your registered project.
- **bearerSession** — user-session endpoints (the signed-in user acting on their own account).

The typed Node client for everything here is `@devsforfun/id-sdk` (public npm).

projectHmac.name: X-DFF-Signature
projectHmac.description:
Project-HMAC authentication for satellite servers. Two headers on every request:

    X-DFF-Project:   <projects.id (uuid)>
    X-DFF-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(payload, signing_secret)>

The signing secret is issued once at project creation/rotation (Developer console → project credentials).
The signed payload depends on the route:
- POST routes: the EXACT raw request body bytes (sign before serializing anything else; never re-stringify).
- GET /api/profile/{userId}: the literal userId.
- GET /api/entitlements/{userId}/{appId}: the literal string `userId:appId`.
- GET /api/sessions?user_id=…: the literal user_id.
- DELETE /api/sessions/{id}: the literal session id.

Comparison is timing-safe; failures return a deliberately coarse 403 (unknown project, bad signature,
suspended app, and not-first-party are indistinguishable). The `@devsforfun/id-sdk` signs automatically.

bearerSession.description: User-session authentication: a devsforfun ID access token (hub-issued JWT) as a Bearer token. Browser calls may instead carry the session cookie set by the hub.

linked_providers.description: Upstream identity providers linked to the account (e.g. google).

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the new avatar.

email.description: Only with the `email` scope AND the email data class enabled.

display_name.description: Only with the `profile` scope AND the profile_basic data class enabled.

bio.description: Present when the user made it public.

links.description: Present when the user made them public.

access_token.description: Hub-issued JWT (verify against the hub JWKS).

id_token.description: OIDC ID token when the openid scope was granted.

code.description: Authorization code from the consent redirect.

code_verifier.description: PKCE verifier matching the code_challenge sent at /oauth/authorize.

redirect_uri.description: Must equal the registered redirect URI.

client_id.description: OAuth client id — the gotrue uuid (what the SDK stores) or the dff_… label.

client_secret.description: Confidential clients only; public (PKCE) clients omit it.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token from the previous response.

client_id.description: Same client identifier as the original grant.

resource.description: Event resource to subscribe to (e.g. user.erasure_requested, or another app’s published <app-slug>.* events you are granted).

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS endpoint to deliver events to (SSRF-guarded).

device_type.description: Coarse device class; "server" = non-browser API client.

SessionLocation.description: Approximate location captured at sign-in from request geo headers; all-null renders as "Unknown".

user_id.description: The user the session belongs to.

not_after.description: Hard expiry, when set; null = no fixed expiry.

event_type.description: Event type, e.g. app_signin_success. IPs are never included.

access_token.description: Opaque access token (1h TTL, stored hashed).

refresh_token.description: Rotating refresh token — each refresh INVALIDATES the previous one; reuse revokes the grant.

token.description: The opaque access token to validate.

matched.description: Whether a pending ack row was updated.

patch.description: Both fields optional; at least one change required (400 no_changes otherwise). Usernames are globally unique — collisions return 409 username_taken.

post.description: multipart/form-data with a single `file` field. JPEG/PNG/WEBP only, size-capped; sets profiles.avatar_url and avatar_source=custom.

200.description: Uploaded; returns the resolved avatar URL.

400.description: invalid_multipart / file_field_required / unsupported_mime / empty_file / file too large.

get.description: Returns the user’s profile to a satellite that holds a live OAuth grant from that user. Field release composes the grant’s OIDC scopes with the per-app data-sharing catalog: `email` needs the email scope AND the email data class enabled; profile fields need the profile scope AND profile_basic enabled; `id`/`sub` always flow. Revoking the app cuts this off entirely (403 no_consent). Signed payload: the literal userId.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

get.description: Unauthenticated. Returns only the fields the user made public via per-field profile visibility (display_name/username/avatar_url default public; everything else default private). 404 when the username doesn’t resolve OR nothing is public — indistinguishable on purpose.

schema.description: The public handle to look up.

parameters.description: The public handle to look up.
parameters.name: username

post.description: RFC 6749 token endpoint, fronting Supabase GoTrue. Authenticated by the OAuth parameters themselves (client_id + PKCE verifier; client_secret for confidential clients) — no separate scheme. Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded or JSON. Errors use the RFC 6749 envelope {error, error_description}. Rate limit: 60/min per client_id.

get.description: Returns claims filtered by the access token’s scope claim (openid → sub; email → email + email_verified; profile → name + picture). Rate limit: 120/min per user.

post.description: Subscribes the calling project to a resource for one user. The returned signing_secret is shown ONCE — store it; deliveries are signed with it (X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=hmac(`${ts}.${body}`)). Signed payload: the raw request body.

post.summary: Publish a custom event to subscribers
post.description: Fans a custom event out to every subscription matching the resource. The event_type MUST be namespaced under the publishing app’s slug (`<app-slug>.<noun>.<verb>`) — publishing under another app’s namespace is rejected. Signed payload: the raw request body.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

get.summary: List sessions of a user in the calling app
get.description: Returns ONLY the sessions and recent auth events attributable to the calling project (cross-app isolation is structural). Requires the user to still have the app connected — revoking from the connected-apps panel cuts this off (403 no_consent), as does opting out of the optional `sessions` data class (403 sharing_disabled). Signed payload: the literal `user_id` value.

schema.description: The user whose sessions to list.

parameters.description: The user whose sessions to list.
parameters.name: user_id

200.description: Sessions + recent auth events for this user in this app.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the calling app’s sessions
delete.description: Deletes the session, signing the user out of the satellite on next token refresh. The session must belong to the calling app — foreign sessions return 404 without leaking whether they exist. Signed payload: the literal session id.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

404.description: Unknown session, or a session that belongs to another app (indistinguishable on purpose).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

get.summary: Pull a user’s entitlement for the calling app
get.description: The satellite-facing entitlement lookup (the SDK caches it for 60s). Gates: the listing must belong to the calling project (403 not_your_listing); the user must still have the app connected (403 no_consent — revoking from connected-apps cuts this off); the entitlements data class must not be opted out (403 sharing_disabled). Signed payload: the literal string `userId:appId`. Rate limit: 120/min per project.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

post.description: For satellites that sell access through their own flows: upserts an entitlement the hub then treats as authoritative. Object-level auth: the app_listing must belong to the calling project. Signed payload: the raw request body. Rate limit: 120/min per project.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Exchange a data-share code or refresh token
post.description: Token endpoint for the cross-app data-share flow. grant_type=authorization_code exchanges the ONE-TIME code minted at user consent; grant_type=refresh_token rotates the pair (the old refresh token is invalidated — replaying it is treated as theft and revokes the whole grant). Authenticated by the code/refresh-token + target client identity, RFC 6749-style. Rate limit: 60/min per client.
Called by the TARGET project to validate a presented data-share access token. Any failure returns {active:false} without detail. Signed payload: the raw request body. Rate limit: 600/min per project.

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

post.description: After the hub fans out user.erasure_requested (account deletion), each satellite wipes its copy of the user’s data and confirms here. A caller can only ack its OWN (user, project) row — the project comes from the HMAC identity, never the body. Signed payload: the raw request body.

200.description: Recorded. matched=false means no pending ack row existed for this (user, project).

403.description: Authentication or authorization failed (coarse on purpose: unknown_project / bad_signature / app_suspended / no_consent are not distinguished beyond the error code).

429.description: Rate limited. Retry-After header carries the wait in seconds.

post.summary: Report user activity in the calling app
post.description: Upserts the user’s activity row for the calling app (unlocks verified-user reviews, feeds analytics). Signed payload: the raw request body. Rate limit: 600/min per project.
